'''Tamarc''' was the leader of a squad of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents sent to track down [[Enid Vahr]] after he went missing on [[Demophon]]. The squad's starship was shot down over Demophon. Only Tamarc, rebel agents [[Almera Zan]] and [[Grashk]], and [[free-trader]] [[Roz]] survived. Afterward [[Sla Kar]], panicking over the approaching [[Demophon supernova]] attacked the rebels for their [[Identichip/Legends|identichips]]. Tamarc was killed in the ensuing melee.<ref name="BE" />
